reviewItem.question: Does "[BUGFIX] Fix duplicate kubelet targets for nodes reporting several addresses of the same IP family" mean a change to protocol-behavior:kube-prometheus-stack|name=kubelet-duplicate-targets|component=prometheus-operator (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: The prometheus-operator bundled in kube-prometheus-stack 90.0.0 (operator v0.93.1) no longer creates duplicate kubelet targets for nodes that report several addresses of the same IP family.
